OPERATIVE NOTE -- Clark Fork Surgical Hospital Date of surgery: 09/21/2083 Patient: Desmond Page Age 61 MRN VBH-7-318402 Room 4 West, bed 12 Surgeon: Dr. Ingrid Valtteri-Osei Assistant: B. Larrabee, RN first assist Anesthesia: GETA
PREOP DX: Ascending colon adenocarcinoma (overlapping malignant neoplasm of colon). POSTOP DX: Same. PROCEDURE: Laparoscopic right hemicolectomy with ileocolic anastomosis.
INDICATIONS: Mr. Page's tumor was found on screening colonoscopy and staged 9/10. I discussed risks at length with him and his wife, Lark Paige, in the pre-op area; consent signed, witnessed by Ransom Page (his son, 34), not by staff?? -- consent form to be redone, witness must be a staff member.
DESCRIPTION: Under GETA, prepped and draped. 4 ports. The right colon was mobilized and the ileocolic pedicle was divided. A 5 cm extraction incision. Specimen out in bag. Side-to-side stapled anastomosis, checked. Fascia closed. EBL 100 mL. Counts correct x2. Tolerated well, to PACU stable.
Smartwatch alarm (patient's, WS-77-4410-B) went off in the pre-op area at 06:12 with GPS 46.8721 N, 113.9940 W (hospital car park).
Please page me for any bleeding: the page goes to pager 4417. Dictated by Ingrid Valtteri-Osei, MD 09/21/2083. Signed: -- I. Valtteri (Dez = patient, I.V. = me)
